company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description:
• Help students in the classes of Data Base Management and Programming Languages.
• Grade homework, projects, and exams.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Part of The Sustainable Water Resources project: a shared understanding of future scenarios of water availability and use in the Middle Rio Grande valley of southern New Mexico, west Texas, and northern Chihuahua.
• Collaborate in The Sustainable Water through Integrated Modeling platform (SWIM) project. 
• Work on the poster that it is going to be presented in the Great Minds in STEM Conference.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of smart mobility innovations and solutions related to the
scalability, modularity, interoperability, resiliency and sustainability of infrastructure and
services.
• Collaborate in the smart cities report that was sent to Casablanca, Morocco.
• Collaborate in the mobile application (SCS) that was generated to create panic alert and
reports

company.name: US-Mexico Interdiciplinary Reaserch Collaboration for Smart Cities (NSF-IRES Program)

positions.title: Employer
positions.description:
• Serve around 25 customers per day and help them find the uniforms, shoes or accessories
they are looking.
• Process payments on the computer through vouchers, payrolls, credit cards and cash.
• Receive boxes, put prices on items and check if any item is for an order.
• Receive and make phone calls, organize the store and check that the paperwork is correct.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
• Took applications of the customer and process it in the finances that we had, check credit
report, organize the invoices and paperwork from customers.
• Data entry of sales, information of customers and reports of every day.
• Receive and make calls, process payments through the phone, make excel formats to
make the data entry easier.

positions.title: Crew Lead
positions.description:
• Took orders and payments, prepare the order and give it to the customer.
• Received the truck with the products, count everything and organize it in its respective
place.
• Trained around 6 new employees in their respective areas of work, give a good
maintenance to all the machines in the store.
